project: UNB Ocean Mapping Group (OMG) Multibeam Sonar Processing Suite
description: Structured tool, CLI flag, file format, and workflow catalog for LocalAI RAG and function-calling agents.

tools.summary: Unpacks Kongsberg SIS 5.x .kmall and .kmwcd files into OMG_HDCS v4 .merged swath files and 20 companion files.

flags.description: Output directory and base filename prefix (e.g. merged/0001_line).
Input raw Kongsberg .kmall or .kmwcd file.
Maximum depth filter in meters; beams deeper than this are flagged rejected.
Minimum depth filter in meters.
Verbose datagram diagnostic output.

preconditions: If a companion .kmwcd file exists for the same line, read_kmall MUST be run on .kmwcd FIRST, its <prefix>.merged renamed to justWC_<prefix>.merged, read_kmall run on .kmall SECOND, and moveOverWCinfo run to combine them.
postconditions: User or script must copy <prefix>.nav_1 to <prefix>.nav before running stripNav or mergeNav.

User or script must copy the active attitude file (.net_att_2 for KM Binary format=1, .net_att_1 for POS/MV GRP 102/103 format=7, or .orientation_1 for EM3000 format=2) to <prefix>.orientation before running newMergeAtt or mergeAtt.

error_signatures.error: NOT Dynamically Recognizing the Echosounder Type
error_signatures.cause: echoSounderID is not in {2040, 2042, 2045, 712, 304, 124} or input is a legacy .all file.
error_signatures.fix: Use RTlite -simrad for .all/.wcd files, or add the new Kongsberg echoSounderID in read_kmall.c.

tools.summary: Unpacks legacy Kongsberg/Simrad .all and .wcd multibeam files into OMG_HDCS .merged and companion files.

flags.description: Output directory and base filename prefix.
Input raw Kongsberg/Simrad .all or .wcd file.
Maximum depth gate in meters.

preconditions: If .wcd exists, unpack .wcd before .all and transfer pointers with moveOverWCinfo.

tools.summary: Copies water column byte offsets and record lengths from a water-column-only .merged file into a bathymetric .merged file.
preconditions: Both .merged files must correspond to the same survey line.
postconditions: The temporary justWC_<line>.merged file can be deleted after completion.

tools.summary: Filters speed jumps and decimates binary OMG .nav files by minimum time interval and distance.

flags.description: Starting record index.
Ending record index.

preconditions: For .kmall workflows, <line>.nav_1 must be copied to <line>.nav first.
postconditions: Decimated navigation is written to decnav/<line>.nav (typically with parameters 0.5 0.01 10.0).

tools.summary: Concatenates individual line .nav files into a continuous multi-line binary .nav file so line boundary pings can be interpolated.
preconditions: Must be executed sequentially (not in parallel on the same master_output.nav file).

tools.summary: Interpolates vessel navigation into .merged ping headers and applies GPS-to-RP lever-arm offsets.

flags.description: Maximum time gap (seconds) across which navigation may be interpolated (typically 60.0).
Reads Nav_X and Nav_Y lever-arm offsets from .param and negates them to convert to RP-relative offsets.
Manual starboard antenna offset (prefer -param instead).
Manual forward antenna offset (prefer -param instead).
Navigation time latency correction in seconds.
Adds N * 1024 GPS weeks to fix GPS week rollover timestamp bugs.

error_signatures.cause: Ping timestamp falls outside the start/end range of the supplied .nav file or gap exceeds -ahead.
error_signatures.fix: Use a concatenated multi-line nav file (appendNav) and pass -ahead 60.0.

tools.summary: Interpolates high-rate attitude (.orientation), recomputes 3D beam launch vectors from transmit sectors, and ray-traces beams through .sv_filtered.

flags.description: Redo sound velocity ray-tracing using <prefix>.sv_filtered.
Recompute 3D beam launch angles using <prefix>.sectors, <prefix>.param, and <prefix>.orientation.
Also update water column beam geometry using <prefix>.watercol and <prefix>.WC_Phase1.

preconditions: <prefix>.orientation must exist and contain valid attitude records (copied from .net_att_2, .net_att_1, or .orientation_1 for .kmall data).

tools.summary: Interpolates ASCII tide heights into .merged ping headers to adjust bathymetric depths.

flags.description: Target .merged file to update in-place.
ASCII tide file (YYYY DDD HH MM SS.SS Tide_m).
Invert sign of tide height before adding to positive downward depths.

tools.summary: Removes Kongsberg's empirical real-time Time-Varying Gain (TVG) ramp from .ss_data snippets to eliminate nadir-to-outer-swath seams.
Converts unpacked multibeam snippets (.ss_data / .16_data) into GLORIA-format (.ss) across-track sidescan scanlines.

flags.description: Across-track bin resolution in meters (e.g., 0.25m shallow, 2.0m deep).
Extend snippet envelopes to prevent gaps between adjacent beam footprints (standard for .kmall).
Read from <prefix>.ss_data_deTVG produced by deTVG instead of <prefix>.ss_data.

tools.summary: Scans .merged or .nav files and prints the geographic bounding box (West East South North).

flags.description: Fast scan using ping navigation headers rather than reading every beam.

tools.summary: Creates a 1024-byte OMG1 raster template (.blank) for bathymetric gridding (-float) or sidescan mosaicking (-8bit -prime 255).

flags.description: Create a 32-bit float grid (data_type=3) initialized to 9999.0 (REQUIRED for weigh_grid / tor4). Must precede -bounds/-boundsof.
Create an 8-bit unsigned char grid (data_type=1) (REQUIRED for mos2 / tomos).
Initial fill value for 8-bit rasters (use -prime 255 for mos2).
East-West cell resolution in meters (must precede -bounds/-boundsof).
North-South cell resolution in meters (must precede -bounds/-boundsof).
Explicit bounding box in decimal degrees (West negative).
Automatically compute bounds from all remaining CLI arguments. Must be the LAST option on the command line.

tools.summary: Accumulates distance-weighted multibeam soundings from .merged files into a 32-bit float .r4 grid and .weight buffer.

flags.description: Target 32-bit float grid (initialized by copying <grid>.blank).
Companion weight accumulation raster.
Smoothing / footprint expansion factor (typically 2.0).
Normalize accumulated weighted depths by total weight to finalize the .r4 depth grid.
Reject beams with grazing angles shallower than <deg>.
Restrict gridding to launch angles within [port, stbd].
Include all beams regardless of swathed manual edit flags.

error_signatures.error: Input file is not a floating point grid
error_signatures.cause: make_blank was invoked without -float (or -float was placed after -boundsof).
error_signatures.fix: Re-run make_blank with -float before -bounds/-boundsof, copy .blank to .r4, remove .weight, and re-run weigh_grid.

tools.summary: Converts a 32-bit float .r4 grid into an 8-bit greyscale raster (.8bit) for display or draping.
Computes an 8-bit directional sun-illuminated hillshade (.sun) from a 32-bit float .r4 bathymetric grid.
Interactive X11/Motif swath editor for inspecting and flagging outlier soundings in .merged files.

flags.description: Opens a plan-view map of <grid.r4> so the user can drag a box around an artifact and jump straight to the intersecting .merged lines.

tools.summary: Interpolates across small along-track ping gaps in GLORIA-format (.ss) sidescan files in-place.
Projects GLORIA-format (.ss) sidescan lines into an 8-bit geographic mosaic (.mos) using a range buffer (.ran) to prioritize near-nadir overlapping swaths.

flags.description: Target 8-bit mosaic raster (initialized from make_blank -8bit -prime 255).
Companion 8-bit range buffer raster (initialized from make_blank -8bit -prime 255).
Across-track/along-track smoothing factor.
Blend overlapping swaths using the .ran distance-from-nadir buffer.
Replace directory prefix <ss_dir> with <merged_dir> when opening companion .merged and .nav files.
